lines.beaver: 아이고, 민준 씨 왔어요? 정말 오랜만이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Oh my, Minjun, you're here? It's been so long.
lines.beaver_roman: aigo, minjun ssi wasseoyo? jeongmal oraenmanieyo.
lines.learner: 선생님, 그동안 잘 지내셨어요? 이제야 찾아뵙네요.
lines.en: Sir, have you been well? I'm only now coming to visit.
lines.roman: seonsaengnim, geudongan jal jinaesyeosseoyo? ijeya chajabwemneyo.

lines.beaver: 이렇게 찾아와 줘서 고마워요. 어서 들어와요.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you for coming. Come on in.
lines.beaver_roman: ireoke chajawa jwoseo gomawoyo. eoseo deureowayo.
lines.learner: 반겨 주셔서 감사합니다. 이거 작은 선물이에요.
lines.en: Thank you for welcoming me. This is a small gift.
lines.roman: bangyeo jusyeoseo gamsahamnida. igeo jageun seonmurieyo.

lines.beaver: 뭘 이런 걸 다. 빈손으로 와도 되는데.
lines.beaver_en: Oh, you shouldn't have. You could've come empty-handed.
lines.beaver_roman: mwol ireon geol da. binsoneuro wado doeneunde.

lines.beaver_en: How polite you are. Sit down and have some tea.
lines.en: I learned it all from you.

lines.beaver: 요즘 회사 생활은 어때요? 힘들지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: How's work these days? Isn't it hard?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum hoesa saenghwareun eottaeyo? himdeulji anayo?
lines.en: It's busy, but my seniors treat me well.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. Do you get along with your coworkers too?
lines.en: Yes, it's an atmosphere of mutual respect, so it's nice.

lines.beaver_en: And how is your mother doing?
lines.en: Yes, my mother is always grateful to you, too.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Please give my regards to your mother.
lines.learner: 어머니께서 꼭 식사 대접을 하고 싶어 하세요.
lines.en: My mother really wants to treat you to a meal.
lines.roman: eomeonikkeseo kkok siksa daejeobeul hago sipeo haseyo.

lines.beaver: 고맙지만 대접은 내가 해야지요. 밥 먹고 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks, but I should be the host. Eat before you go.
lines.beaver_roman: gomapjiman daejeobeun naega haeyajiyo. bap meokgo gayo.
lines.learner: 아닙니다 제가 오늘은 바빠서 다음에 또 찾아뵐게요.
lines.en: No, I'm busy today, so I'll come visit you again next time.
lines.roman: animnida jega oneureun bappaseo daeume tto chajabwelgeyo.

lines.beaver: 허허, 그럼 다음에 또 찾아와요. 기다릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Ha ha, then come again next time. I'll be waiting.
lines.beaver_roman: heoheo, geureom daeume tto chajawayo. gidarilgeyo.
lines.en: Yes, I'll visit often. Please stay healthy, sir.
